questions.question: If you speak with your academic advisor, does delaying graduation by one term push back any course prerequisite that is offered only once a year?

questions.question: Can you ask the hiring manager or a recent team intern what typical daily responsibilities look like and how 1-on-1 mentorship is structured?
questions.why_first: Because your main anxiety about accepting is mentorship quality, and a 15-minute conversation could resolve this unknown directly.

questions.question: Does the company historically extend full-time offers to interns upon graduation, or is this primarily short-term project coverage?
questions.why_first: Because a high conversion rate transforms this from an academic delay into a secured post-graduation career path.

questions.question: If you decline this offer to finish on schedule, what concrete alternative project or summer internship will provide equivalent resume evidence?
questions.why_first: Because declining is only a clear win if you have a viable substitute for the industry experience you seek.
